outcome: Duration of the third stage of labor
cohort: 133 women with twin vaginal deliveries and 132 women with singleton vaginal deliveries
finding: Twin pregnancy is associated with a longer third stage of labor, particularly at the extremes, and increased estimated blood loss.
mod_finding: Twin pregnancies are associated with longer third stages of labor at the extremes and increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, so it is recommended to deliver the placenta within 15 minutes to reduce this risk.
